'In' in Sanskrit means 'within' or 'abiding'. 'Rama' is a name of God and signifies divine protection and loving grace. Thus, the name Inira represents the idea of dwelling within the divine, residing in the realm of the gods. For Hindus, the name is a reminder to keep the divine presence within and to live in a state of surrender and devotion to the higher power.
